# clickhouse_saved_query (Resource)

Use this resource to save a named SQL query for a ClickHouse Cloud service. The saved query can be opened and run in the SQL console.

For more information, see [Saving a query](https://clickhouse.com/docs/products/cloud/features/sql-console-features/sql-console#saving-a-query).

~> **Note:** This resource is in beta. Its behavior may change in future provider versions.

You can import an existing saved query if it was created through the saved queries API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "service_id" {
  description = "ID of an existing ClickHouse Cloud service."
  type        = string
}

resource "clickhouse_saved_query" "example" {
  service_id = var.service_id

  name     = "Example query"
  sql      = "SELECT 1 AS value"
  database = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) Database used by the saved query.
- `name` (String) Name of the saved query.
- `service_id` (String) ID of the ClickHouse Cloud service for the saved query.
- `sql` (String) Saved SQL query.

### Optional

- `parameters` (Map of String) Default query parameters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the saved query.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# Import by service_id:query_id.
terraform import clickhouse_saved_query.example 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222:33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333
```
